I have been on 14 "AI strategy" calls with prospects since the start of the quarter.

On 11 of them the person running the call had a document open called some variant of AI_strategy_v3_FINAL.

On 9 of them the document was a list of vendors.

On 6 of them the list included us, which is presumably why we were on the call, and on 2 of them it included a company that shut down in February.

Nobody on any of the 14 calls could name one task their company had stopped doing because of AI. Several could name tasks they had added. Reviewing AI output, mostly.

We have one of the documents too. Ours is called AI_strategy_v4_FINAL_final.
